github_release_name.rule: GitHub Release names use the product-prefixed v-version format for both Stable and Nightly; tags remain v<version> for updater and automation compatibility.

stable.target_reader: ordinary App users and release operators deciding whether to install, upgrade, promote, or troubleshoot the Stable package

nightly.target_reader: opt-in testers, maintainers, and operators validating the latest prerelease
lead_with: new user-visible behavior since the previous Nightly

template_policy.rule: Template release notes preserve evidence facts and technical details only when the operator requested a dry-run or diagnostic preview; template output is not the default polished public Stable or Nightly copy and must not be silently published from the release critical path.

public_release_notes.public_asset_policy: Release-note evidence JSON and technical audit output are operator evidence, not public download assets; the public GitHub Release asset list stays focused on install, update, checksum, and manifest entrypoints.
public_release_notes.rule: Public release notes use prepared user copy derived from script-generated evidence before the expensive release train starts. Publish and promote jobs must not call AI to generate or replace notes on the critical path. The body leads with user scenarios, upgrade value, and action items; commit logs, refs, workflow facts, changelog details, and packaging audit material belong in Technical details or evidence artifacts instead of the main narrative.

dmg_compression.metadata_blockmap_gate: node --experimental-strip-types scripts/validate-release.ts release-assets plus focused hdiutil imageinfo/verify readback from a standard macOS build artifact
dmg_compression.rule: Standard macOS DMG uses electron-builder-supported ULFO by default because electron-builder 26.8.1 does not accept ULMO in dmg.format. ULMO for standard assets requires a separate postprocess patch that proves canonical updater metadata, ZIP blockmap, and latest-arm64-mac.yml still match the published assets before it can replace the default; latest-mac.yml and DMG blockmap files are legacy compatibility assets only when deliberately published.

macos_app_bundle_trust.verification: npm run verify-remote-release on macos-latest downloads the published ZIP, extracts One Person Lab.app, verifies the bundle version, records codesign/spctl/signature diagnostics, and accepts ad-hoc or unsigned bundles only when standard-local-authorization-policy.json declares Stable local authorization with quarantine removal required
macos_app_bundle_trust.rule: standard updater replacement is App-managed local authorization: the updater ZIP must contain the expected One Person Lab.app bundle, and release evidence must include the standard local authorization policy rather than requiring paid Apple Developer ID signing

standard_updater.rule: standard updater metadata is canonical arm64-only latest-arm64-mac.yml, must never point to Full first-install assets, and standard updater ZIP assets must contain the expected One Person Lab.app bundle plus local authorization evidence; latest-mac.yml is a legacy compatibility alias only when deliberately published.

draft_refresh.scope: standard App DMG, ZIP, ZIP blockmap, canonical arm64 updater metadata, and local authorization policy before Stable promotion

post_update_dependency_reconcile.rule: After the new App version is actually running, the App requests the Framework-owned OPL Flow optimize transaction. The standard updater still targets only the App binary and never implements skill cleanup or profile mutation itself.

local_data_lifecycle.policy_surface: Settings / Storage and Settings / Updates & Maintenance

storage_inventory.rule: Storage inventory must show App-managed local data roots and cleanup modes before any destructive action. It is the required readback surface before archive, prune, rotation, or cache cleanup execution.

updater_cache.rule: Updater cache cleanup may delete stale downloaded installer packages, but must preserve pending recovery metadata and the currently selected update package until install is applied or replaced. Retired updater cache roots are no longer active install roots and may remove downloaded installer packages while preserving recovery metadata and non-package files.

logs.rule: Logs may be bounded or cleaned through a user-visible maintenance action, but log cleanup must not be used as proof that user artifacts were retained, archived, or removed.

user_data_artifacts.rule: Conversations, workspaces, generated artifacts, results, papers, baselines, reports, and narrative/intermediate deliverables are user data artifacts. The App must not silently delete them; cleanup requires inventory, archive/export, restore-proof, and explicit user confirmation.

runtime_substrate.rule: OPL Runtime Fabric cleanup follows the managed runtime pointer and rollback policy, not the Electron standard updater cache policy. Prune must start as a dry-run plan and may only target runtime roots not referenced by current or rollback pointers.

nightly_standard.rule: Each Nightly workflow attempt creates a unique immutable prerelease tag and release, publishes standard macOS arm64 updater assets only, and remains visible only to prerelease opt-in update checks; the moving nightly image tag is a channel pointer, not version identity.

webui_full.rule: Stable Docker WebUI images must be payload-capable runtime images. A metadata-only image may not be promoted as the beginner default.

webui_slim.rule: Slim images may carry only WebUI, AionCore, bootstrap, and seed metadata, but must not be tagged stable or documented as the default beginner path.

runtime_image_contract.rule: Docker/WebUI starts as a preheated WebUI runtime image: the image gets users to a browser quickly, while OPL Framework owns reconciliation and managed updates inside the mounted /data state.

github_package_access.configuration_surface: GitHub Packages settings Manage Actions access
github_package_access.public_api_policy: GitHub does not expose a stable public REST or GraphQL endpoint for configuring personal package repository association or Actions access; configure these gates through the package settings UI.
github_package_access.rule: App-owned WebUI GHCR publishing requires the one-person-lab-webui package to be associated with gaofeng21cn/one-person-lab-app and to grant write Actions access to gaofeng21cn/one-person-lab-app before App workflows can update existing GHCR tags.

retention_policy.rule: WebUI GHCR cleanup must retain protected moving tags, recent stable/nightly versions, and declared rollback tags; deletion is never part of ordinary release publishing.

webui_ghcr_image.rule: WebUI GHCR image publish truth is App-owned server deployment artifact truth for the preheated WebUI runtime image. The desktop App embeds the AionUI shell through App packaging; ordinary desktop users do not install this container package. Framework may reference the image coordinate and owns OPL-managed reconciliation inside /data, but it does not own GHCR publishing.

cask_install_policy.rule: Homebrew user and CI installs use the fully qualified standard cask ref and trust only the standard plus conflicts_with sibling cask refs so installation stays explicit without granting broad trust to the whole tap.

tap_update_policy.direct_commit_conflict_policy: serialize same channel/version tap writes across package kinds; on non-fast-forward push, fetch origin main, rebase the local tap commit, and retry before failing

codex_cli.verification: App-owned runtime/current/bin/codex must satisfy minimum_version, execute offline from the packaged archive wrapper, and pass Codex functional smoke; system PATH/Homebrew/global Codex may be reported as diagnostics but is not the default runtime source

temporal_cli.verification: App-owned runtime/current/bin/temporal must satisfy minimum_version, execute offline from the packaged archive wrapper, and pass Temporal provider smoke; system PATH/Homebrew/global Temporal may be reported as diagnostics but is not the default runtime source

temporal_runtime_provider.verification: Full manifest runtime_assertions.temporal_core_bridge_releases must be exactly aarch64-apple-darwin and wrapper must export local Temporal defaults

bun_cli.verification: Full manifest optional_components.bun records packaged or not_packaged status

size_policy.goal: Keep Full first-install complete and offline-capable while making size growth visible and reviewable.

threshold_semantics.above_review_threshold_rule: A Full DMG above the review threshold must open package-size review and optimization planning, but it must not authorize removing required offline first-install payloads.
threshold_semantics.stable_release_coupling_rule: Full DMG warning or review-threshold status is not release-blocking by size alone and must not block stable clean evidence unless a hard size limit, uncompressed runtime limit, offline payload boundary, native trust, or Full clean VM smoke gate fails.
threshold_semantics.cache_hit_rule: A Full runtime cache hit only proves reusable package assembly input; it is never App release readiness, runtime dependency truth, or OPL family production readiness.

optimization_artifacts.rule: Optimization evidence is part of the Full package manifest/readback surface and may only prove explicit non-runtime pruning plus boundary preservation; it cannot replace Full clean VM smoke or owner receipt evidence.

standard.role: ordinary App package and standard updater target

full.role: clean-machine first-install package with bundled runtime payloads

offline_kit.role: manual diagnostic/runtime recovery artifact that consumes the same OPL runtime bundle manifest boundary

opl_full_runtime.role: offline first-install runtime payload assembled from the OPL runtime bundle manifest; dependency truth remains in OPL

aionui_bundled_runtime.role: AionUI shell runtime required by the App bundle

measured_records.conclusion: Compression level 9 alone cannot bring the measured Full DMG back under the 750000000-byte review threshold.

optimization_priority_order.rule: Reduce duplicated runtime payloads and layer contents only when Full offline Core readiness and native trust evidence remain intact.
Remove non-runtime shell assets, maps, tests, caches, or reports without changing App-owned GUI behavior or shell authority boundaries.
Treat Electron footprint work as shell/runtime-carrier optimization; do not replace it with an unsupported carrier during release packaging.
Use compression tuning as secondary size reduction only; the v26.6.21 zlib-level=9 estimate remains above the review threshold.

draft_refresh.scope: Full first-install assets and Full release-note section before Stable promotion only

release_efficiency_boundary.rule: Full runtime bundle preparation belongs to OPL Framework. The App Full release consumes the bundle manifest, lock, env contract, and readback refs and packages required offline payloads; it does not own dependency truth or add runtime materialization to the release critical path.

release_preflight.failure_budget: fail before standard or Full builds start

source_gate.rule: The App release source gate must fail before expensive build, VM, Full, Homebrew, or WebUI work when App release-boundary validation, shell format/type, shell ref resolution, or framework ref resolution is invalid.

release_preflight.rule: Every App release train must pass preflight and the source gate before starting expensive standard, Full, VM, Homebrew, WebUI, or publish jobs.

stable_release_state_machine.authority_boundary: The stable release session coordinates an explicitly authorized release but is not release truth. Same-cohort evidence, candidate validation, owner receipt, promotion readback, Homebrew readback, and installed App verification remain authoritative for their own states.

full_train_rerun_allowed_when: pinned source refs changed by release owner decision
built artifact is invalid or missing
candidate record cannot bind evidence to the frozen cohort

primary_repair_order: make cohort and retry state explicit
fix implementation defects exposed by targeted gates

target_architecture.rule: A stable release freezes one App/Shell/Framework cohort, builds and qualifies artifacts once, and uses the cohort manifest, readiness summary, candidate record, owner receipt, and targeted gate reruns for recovery and promote. Standard stable readiness is admitted from the Standard critical path by default; Full, Docker/WebUI, and Homebrew add-on gates stay same-cohort recorded gates in release-addon-readiness-summary and may be required by release owner policy before promote without blocking the Standard readiness record.

cohort_prepare.purpose: separate currentness preparation from stable release dispatch by recording the exact pinned cohort refs before expensive release gates

release_intent_policy.rule: Every Stable dispatch declares whether it is a complete Stable including Full or an intentionally Standard-only hotfix. A Standard-only run must expose its Full omission reason in preflight and release summaries and cannot be presented as the complete Stable train.

operator_plan_policy.rule: desktop-release rejects a dispatch whose inputs do not match the pinned cohort plan digest; raw dispatch without release:cohort-plan is not a supported release entry.

stable_candidate_freeze.currentness_rule: A stable candidate is current only for the pinned App SHA, shell SHA, and framework SHA cohort. Remote movement after freeze is post-freeze drift: it may justify freezing a new cohort, but it must not make the completed candidate claim closeout-time latest or force a desktop release rerun when the same frozen cohort only needs owner receipt and promote.

cohort_prepare.authority_boundary: cohort plan is an operator planning artifact only; it cannot publish a release, claim release-ready, write runtime truth, or replace same-cohort release evidence

primary_blocker_policy.rule: After a critical release gate fails, is stale, cancelled, or superseded, operator status must report a terminal blocker state with repair_source_gate or dispatch_new_cohort guidance instead of continuing to wait on gh run watch.

release_operator.authority_boundary: release operator is a thin controller over existing release scripts, workflows, and artifacts; it must not become release truth, publish by implication, claim release-ready, or write runtime/domain truth

release_monitor.authority_boundary: release monitor is an operator status and diagnostic routing surface only; it is not release truth, cannot publish a release, cannot write runtime truth, and cannot claim release-ready. Release-ready still requires same-cohort evidence, release candidate record, and owner receipt.

attempt_strategy_switch.rule: After three prior attempts for the same version inside 90 minutes, the next dispatch must carry a same-cohort gate reuse plan ref. The time budget changes strategy but never abandons an authorized release goal.

gate_reuse.authority_boundary: reuse plan is a decision artifact only; it cannot claim release-ready, publish a release, write runtime truth, or skip a workflow gate unless a workflow explicitly consumes a reuse_allowed decision

tart_base_prebake.truth_boundary: prebaked Tart base can reduce host setup latency only; clean App install, first launch, Settings smoke, assistant route smoke, and release readiness still come from the VM smoke artifact

full_dmg_compression.rule: Stable Full CI uses ULMO for the App-owned fallback/rebuilt DMG path by default. UDZO remains available as a legacy diagnostic override with zlib level 9 by default. Release readiness still records compressed Full DMG size from the published GitHub asset; crossing the review threshold opens package-size review but does not authorize removing required offline first-install payloads.

full_runtime_packaging_hygiene.policy_summary_boundary: This release contract records the policy owner and evidence surfaces only. Runtime tree filters, package filters, app-bundle trim rules, protected payloads, validation examples, and expected absent paths are not duplicated here; they live in the source_of_truth contract and must be read through the policy audit.
full_runtime_packaging_hygiene.app_policy: exclude local indexes, dependency caches, tests, package docs/fixtures/examples, Python stdlib tests, and user/runtime state; do not prune declared offline first-install payloads, Codex/Temporal archives, domain modules, or packaged skills; do not infer domain truth or artifact authority from package pruning

new_release_upload_failure_cleanup.scope: release created by the current publish invocation before asset upload
new_release_upload_failure_cleanup.rule: If standard or Full asset upload fails after creating a new draft or release, delete that newly-created incomplete release and tag so the next same-cohort attempt starts from a clean remote state.

post_publish_remote_verification.public_asset_policy: GitHub Release assets are user/install/update/checksum entrypoints only. Release-note evidence, Full size summaries, build timing, and workflow telemetry stay in Actions artifacts or step summaries so the public download list remains short and operator evidence remains cohort-bound.

release_mode_boundaries.new_release: normal stable path: draft candidate, same-cohort evidence, owner receipt, then desktop-release-promote.yml publishes stable/latest
release_mode_boundaries.draft_candidate: diagnostic candidate path only; it does not publish stable/latest and cannot be promoted without a promote-ready candidate record plus owner resolution
release_mode_boundaries.refresh_existing: unpublished draft repair only; the draft tag may move with lease to the pinned App commit, then the complete cohort must be published through the promote workflow; published Stable and prerelease releases are immutable

checks: gh release view v<version> returns tagName, isDraft, isPrerelease, publishedAt, and assets
gh release list marks v<version> as latest
stable release is non-draft, non-prerelease, latest, published, and has readable assets
promote_post_publish_readback.rule: The promote workflow must not start Homebrew tap updates until the just-published Stable GitHub Release and matching tag are readable from remote APIs.

desktop_release_concurrency.rule: A newer run for the same version and same release mode queues behind the active run instead of cancelling expensive release work. Superseding an active or queued run must be an explicit operator action that records the old run as stale or superseded; new_release and refresh_existing must not block each other because their concurrency groups remain separate.

release_readiness_admission.rule: Release readiness admission must fail when Standard stable critical-path gates fail. By default it must not force Full, Docker/WebUI, or Homebrew add-on gates before writing the Standard readiness record; those gates keep running in the same cohort and their success, skipped, or failed statuses remain recorded in the add-on readiness summary. require_addon_gates_for_stable_readiness records the release owner expectation for promote-time policy without delaying the Standard readiness record. Clean Windows Docker VM evidence remains optional diagnostic import. Diagnostic gates such as operator evidence bundle validation must feed the add-on summary when present, but they must not prevent Standard readiness aggregation from running.

bootstrap_only.purpose: fast App launch and bootstrap blocker capture before rerunning a full release train
keeps: wrapper smoke command and log artifacts

release_gate.purpose: full deterministic VM release gate used by stable release workflows
keeps: wrapper smoke command and log artifacts
release_gate.critical_failure_artifact_policy: write vm-gate-failure-summary.json/md before uploading large VM artifacts; classify missing large artifacts separately as diagnostic_artifact_missing and recommend rerun_diagnostic_same_artifact
release_gate.wrapper_diagnostic_policy: host_wrapper_preflight_and_smoke_logs_are_supporting_evidence; full release gate failure still comes from the deterministic VM readiness/settings/route/codex checks

writes: temporary standard DMG diagnostic artifact only

scheduled_desktop_release_activity_guard.rule: Scheduled maintenance must not occupy the self-hosted first-run VM runner while a desktop release is active, queued, or cannot be checked.

first_run_vm_concurrency.rule: Scheduled VM smokes collapse stale backlog and default to a focused bootstrap-launch diagnostic; stable release-called VM profiles must use run/profile-scoped groups so standard, Homebrew, and Full install gates cannot cancel or replace each other.

first_run_vm_artifact_handoff.source_run_download_command: actions/download-artifact@v8 with run-id=<release_artifact_run_id || github.run_id> and name=<release_artifact_name>
first_run_vm_artifact_handoff.rule: Branch-lane or post-release evidence runs may explicitly download a DMG-only artifact from a completed source Actions run without publishing assets; this handoff is VM evidence only and must not replace stable same-run VM gates or published asset verification.

vm_local_authorization_policy.rule: Stable first-run VM smokes must clear quarantine after install, record codesign and spctl diagnostics before launch, and continue when codesign or spctl rejects the unsigned locally authorized App.

settings_page_readiness_policy.rule: Settings VM readiness is semantic and structural. User-facing copy may change without failing a healthy packaged page; route, stable page anchor, navigation, nonempty content, and absence of blocking loading or first-run layers remain release-blocking.

assistant_route_smoke_policy.rule: Standard proves that uninstalled professional Agent Packages remain discoverable but cannot launch and expose a repair path. Full proves the installed packages can launch and persist route receipts. A Standard launch gate must never be counted as a Full route receipt.

vm_gates.precondition: VM image already has Homebrew installed

ai_exploratory_policy.rule: AI-assisted exploratory UI checks can discover issues but cannot block or clear release readiness without a deterministic gate.

nightly_standard.purpose: fast prerelease confidence for users who opt into standard updater Nightly builds

stable.purpose: complete user-install proof before a stable App Release is treated as smooth
stable.heavy_gate_policy: run before stable promotion; may be skipped only for draft or emergency packaging refreshes that are not called stable-complete
forbidden_inferences: stable/latest promotion from draft evidence bundle alone
family production readiness from App release/user-path evidence
MAS/MAG/RCA/OBF domain readiness from App release/user-path evidence
runtime truth from App UI rendering

release_cohort.rule: A release evidence bundle can support packaged App evidence only when every artifact belongs to the same App release cohort. Partial readouts may preserve an unknown cohort, but passed bundles must declare release_cohort and the remote verification artifact must match its version/tag.

required_artifacts.producer: packaged GUI Codex post-install functional check

optional_diagnostic_artifacts.producer: packaged GUI Codex AI-first post-install self-check

operator_evidence_bundle.acceptance_rule: App records and displays cohort-bound refs-only release evidence produced by OPL/runtime/domain owners; it does not reinterpret the bundle as runtime truth, domain truth, artifact authority, a quality verdict, stable/latest promotion, or family production readiness.

can_support: Runtime page acceptance for the same release cohort
packaged GUI route smoke for the same release cohort
App release owner promotion review input
cannot_support: stable/latest promotion without explicit release owner decision

release_owner_verdict.next_owner_action: record release_owner_verdict_ref or release_owner_receipt_ref for the same App release cohort, or record release_owner_typed_blocker_ref, typed_blocker_ref, or human_gate_ref when release-ready cannot be authorized

forbidden: rerun desktop-release solely for owner receipt metadata
reinterpret draft candidate evidence as published stable/latest
post_owner_receipt_fast_path.rule: When the only missing input is the release-owner verdict or receipt for the same frozen cohort, validate the post-owner candidate record and dispatch desktop-release-promote.yml; do not rerun desktop-release just to carry owner-resolution metadata.

release_owner_verdict.rule: Same-cohort release/user-path evidence can feed the App release owner review, but until the owner records release_owner_verdict_ref or release_owner_receipt_ref, OPL operating-maturity must keep app_release_user_path at evidence_recorded_not_release_ready_claim. Pending verdicts, install evidence refs, typed blockers, and human gate refs are explicit non-ready release-owner states.

managed_update_plane.status_consumption_policy: App consumes status, conditions, progress refs, and repair action refs only; App does not implement OPL Base or OPL Packages mutation.

software_lifecycle.carrier_alignment_rule: Carrier choice does not change software-object identity or lifecycle authority. Full carriers may seed payloads, but Framework lifecycle owns Base and Packages activation, reconciliation, update, repair, rollback, and uninstall.
